NORTHSTAR LABS MOSCOW OFFICE GUIDE

The Moscow office is located in Aurora Tower, 17 Lesnaya Street, floor 8. Employees may enter the office from 08:00 until 22:00 every day. Reception is staffed on business days from 09:00 until 18:00.

The guest wireless network is named NSL-Guest. Its current password is not included in this guide and must be requested from reception on arrival.

Visitor passes must be ordered before 16:00 on the previous business day. The host must meet each visitor at reception and remain responsible for the visitor while they are in restricted areas.

Car parking must be reserved before 18:00 on the previous business day. Unused reservations should be cancelled before 09:00. The bicycle room is on level minus one; the shared equipment locker is B-14.

Meeting rooms are named after constellations. Orion seats 12 people and includes video conferencing equipment. Lyra seats 6 people. Draco seats 4 people and does not have a display.

Facilities requests should be sent to facilities@northstar.example. Critical issues involving water, electricity, or physical access should also be reported to reception by phone.
